theme.title: Broad Risk-Off
theme.summary: Energy (-0.79%) and Industrials (-0.88%) led the market today, while Health Care (-1.94%) and Financials (-1.71%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -1.21%, defensives -1.42%, and value/cyclicals -1.15% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -1.36%, Dow -1.85%, Nasdaq -1.16% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -1.55%. The VIX rose 17.48% to 26.88, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.69% to $3,850.50, crude oil was little changed at $85.44, and bitcoin slipped 1.38% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
